title: Envelope
description: Response envelope of every financial tool. Every number the agent may state is a fact; every assumption it must mention is a warning.

data.description: Tool-specific payload; see contracts/outputs. Null unless status is OK.

snapshot_id.description: Hash of model source version, as_of, params_version and inputs. Stored by the audit log as forecast_snapshot_id.

derivation.description: How the value was derived. Facts forwarded from the ledger estimator (ADR-017, Proposed; ledger source only) end with the fixed suffix '; source=ledger-estimator; estimator_snapshot=<estimator snapshot_id>; tool_snapshot=<this envelope's snapshot_id>'. Key, value and unit are unchanged.

message.description: Plain-language assumption. Forwarded estimator warnings omit unbounded dynamic counts and raw ledger text (merchant, category, label, txn_id); ADR-016's bounded seasonal-month count is unchanged. In ledger mode they are appended after the tool's own warnings (ADR-017, Proposed).

must_mention.description: The explanation passes if it contains any of these tokens (case-insensitive substring). Every token is a substring of the caveat's own message.

money.description: Integer minor units of the snapshot currency (CLP has none).
